Now showing: Effective Consulting — seventeen prize-nominated creative pieces
by first year medical students, hung in a walkable gallery. Press E at any work to read its story.
Some pieces reflect on bereavement, trauma, eating disorders and death.
Take the rooms at your own pace — there are benches when you need one.
